Chapter 5 · Precision landing

The safe window ✓ COMPLETE

R2 / COURIER ROVER“The relay's sensor is rated for 11.0 m/s downward, maximum. I would also like to land at least 0.30 m from both edges. Purely for dignity.”

The ramp speed is fixed at 16.0 m/s. A landing is safe only when both are true:

  • R2 lands at least 0.30 m inside both pad edges: 24.3 m ≤ Δx ≤ 26.2 m
  • R2's downward speed is small enough: |vfy| ≤ 11.0 m/s
